description:
Project Overview

The University of Sydney offers a Postgraduate Research Supplementary Scholarship in Data Intensive Drug Discovery. This $10,000 supplementary stipend scholarship supports a PhD student to undertake research in data challenges to advance decision-making in drug discovery enabled by data science.

The scholarship is provided through a partnership between the Sydney Precision Data Science Centre (SPDS) and the Drug Discovery Initiative (DDI).

Research position overview

This is a supplementary award, not a complete PhD funding package. Applicants must already hold or be applying for a primary stipend scholarship and meet the relevant University of Sydney affiliation requirements. The scholarship provides AUD 10,000 per annum for up to 4 research periods.

Research Areas

  • Data-intensive drug discovery
  • Precision data science
  • AI and machine learning for biomedical decision-making
  • Computational pharmacology
  • Biomedical data integration
